name: append only: two entries added at the end
spec_quote: `changed_numbers(before, after)` takes two lists (the qa list before and after) and returns the 1-based numbers of the entries in `after` that are new or differ from the entry at the same position in `before`, in order; an unchanged entry is not listed; removed entries are ignored.

spec_quote: `changed_numbers(before, after)` ... returns the 1-based numbers of the entries in `after` that are new or differ from the entry at the same position in `before`, in order; an unchanged entry is not listed; removed entries are ignored.
